statement: A restriction whose subject is a player ("you cannot declare attacks, except with ...") is an effect on players: a monster unaffected by card effects is still bound by it. One whose subject is monsters ("your monsters cannot attack directly") is an effect on them, and doesn't reach an unaffected one.
scripts: Elfnote June Pride's script writes its lock on monsters, with IGNORE_IMMUNE so that it binds them all.
